pure-announcement.rationale: It is the introduction page of a project's documentation book, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: code-knowledge-graph is the closest neighbour but covers graph databases of code structure, not incremental parsing or parser generation.

unfalsifiable.rationale: It is the project's own documentation with the runtime source and six underlying research papers linked for verification.

durability.rationale: The four design properties (general, per-keystroke fast, error-robust, dependency-free C11) are tree-sitter's enduring identity, but the bulk of the capture is binding and parser adoption lists the page itself warns may be incomplete or out of date.

actionability.rationale: It supports at most the decision to pick tree-sitter and find a binding; every how-to (grammars, queries, incremental editing API) lives in later chapters this capture does not include.

atomicity.rationale: It is one idea — an incremental, error-tolerant parser generator with an embeddable runtime — statable in a single paragraph.
